key_concepts: Forces are vector quantities with magnitude and direction.
Free-body diagrams use arrows to show relative magnitude and direction of forces.
Net force is the vector sum of all forces acting on an object.
Balanced forces have equal magnitude and opposite directions, producing zero net force.
An object with balanced forces stays at rest or moves at constant speed in the same direct
Unbalanced forces produce a nonzero net force.
Unbalanced forces can change an object's speed, direction, or both.
The direction of motion follows the direction of the net force.
